scope: Eight-gate hardening review with deterministic admission, read-only audit guard, and daily fallback tests; no live Graphify workflow rerun

cases: Current audit preserves all seven non-PASS blockers
Fabric audit guards database reads and rolls back while keeping report output repo-local
Missing required predicate blocks even when overall verdict says safe
Non-PASS predicate blocks even when overall verdict says safe
All required predicates and SAFE_TO_PROJECT verdict are required
Missing or malformed predicate collections fail closed
Daily aliases gate before child stages
Admission requirements match the fabric audit producer
Projection admission failure cannot use fallback
Snapshot binding failure cannot use fallback
Open lifecycle failure cannot use fallback
Apply child failure cannot use fallback

hardeningGates.name: Preflight and side-effect boundary
hardeningGates.evidence: Static test verifies guarded read-only SQL, READ ONLY transaction, rollback, repo-local report output, and apply aliases gated before child stages.
hardeningGates.notProven: No live environment/dependency/permission probe was run; Graphify daily was intentionally not rerun.

hardeningGates.name: Frozen input and provenance
hardeningGates.evidence: Audit digest, generated timestamp, repository commit, and source-manifest digest from the supplied dry-run are recorded.
hardeningGates.notProven: No second live audit replay was performed to establish run-to-run determinism.

hardeningGates.name: Identity and contract checks
hardeningGates.evidence: The current frozen audit reports partial symbol/semantic/latent qualification and an unsealed ordinal map; the guard tests preserve these blockers.

hardeningGates.name: Projection admission
hardeningGates.evidence: Tests prove missing or non-PASS predicates prevent admission; the frozen audit has 4/11 PASS and 7 blockers.
hardeningGates.notProven: The live admission command was not rerun.

hardeningGates.name: Independent write readback
hardeningGates.evidence: No apply/write was authorized or attempted; the supplied audit reports a read-only transaction and rollback.
hardeningGates.notProven: Independent datastore readback after an authorized test write.

hardeningGates.name: Failure and recovery
hardeningGates.evidence: Tests cover admission, snapshot-binding, lifecycle, and child-stage failures; fallback is not reached even when enabled.
hardeningGates.notProven: Apply idempotency, interrupted-write recovery, and cleanup require an authorized isolated write test.

hardeningGates.name: Operational bounds and observability
hardeningGates.evidence: Local focused test suite completed in 389.6 ms.
hardeningGates.notProven: Live service health, database latency, resource ceilings, GPU use, and production alerting.

hardeningGates.name: Release and promotion gate
hardeningGates.evidence: Seven admission predicates remain below PASS; release requires all mandatory proof gates plus approved write/readback and operations checks.
hardeningGates.notProven: Production promotion, rollback drill, and monitoring acceptance.

limitations: Tests exercise the pure admission summary and static daily failure guards, not PostgreSQL connectivity or live table contents.
The audit source digest identifies the report present when this receipt was prepared; it does not independently verify the database assertions in that report.
No source extraction, embedding, ordinal-map rebuild, projection alignment, BitFrost warmup, ACE admission, or ContextManifest readback was attempted.
